about: The hub as a witness (KEL §2.7, H-1 to H-5, H-10 to H-13; core §2.12.2, CORE-K16). POST /agents/kel:push takes a key history the hub holds extended or the same (200 {aid, seq, head, unchanged}: the tip it now holds; the same history again is unchanged), and refuses an older one (409 kel_rollback), a fork (409 kel_fork), one that does not decode or is another AID's (400 kel_invalid), a new event more than 5 minutes ahead of its clock (400 kel_ts_out_of_window), an AID it holds nothing of (404 unknown_aid) and a body it does not take (400 bad_request); a pushed dip deregisters the agent. GET /agents/{aid}/kel is {aid, kel, registered}: false for the tombstone of an agent that left, 404 unknown_aid for an AID with no record here. /register takes a key history whose tip names this hub (else 400 witness_not_this_hub, which check_only does not ask), refuses a deactivated identity (410 aid_deactivated) and a new event dated more than 5 minutes from its clock (400 kel_ts_out_of_window), and carries the notice it signs; /relay/poll carries the caller's notice, or key_state_notice_error not_witness. A request signed with a key its signer rotated away from is 401 key_retired; an X-ANet-AID that is not an AID is 401 unauthorized. The cases run in order against one hub, whose clock stands still (the notices are fixed bytes).

cases.name: the history held, pushed, is unchanged
an extension is taken and its tip answered
the extension pushed again is unchanged
cases.cite: KEL §2.7: a push repeated is idempotent

cases.name: the held history extended is served
an older history is kel_rollback
a forked history is kel_fork
an event 10 minutes ahead of the clock is kel_ts_out_of_window

body.error: A new key event is dated more than 5 minutes after this hub's clock; correct the system clock and sign the event again.

cases.name: another AID's history is kel_invalid
bytes that are no key history are kel_invalid
an AID the hub holds nothing of is unknown_aid

body.error: This hub holds no key history for this AID; push it to the hubs that witnessed it.

cases.name: an unknown member is bad_request
an aid that is not an AID is bad_request
a poll signed with the key rotated away from is key_retired

body.error: The request is signed with a key the signer has since rotated away from; sign it again with the current key.

cases.name: a pushed dip deregisters
the tombstone is served as not registered
a deactivated identity does not register
the history of an AID with no record here is unknown_aid
the hub's own history is served
a registration whose tip names this hub carries the notice
an identity that names no witness yet is witness_not_this_hub

body.error: The latest event in the key history does not name this hub as its witness; add a rotation that names this hub, then register again.

cases.name: check_only does not ask for the witness
an identity that names another hub is witness_not_this_hub

body.error: The latest event in the key history does not name this hub as its witness; add a rotation that names this hub, then register again.

cases.name: naming this hub 10 minutes before its clock is kel_ts_out_of_window

body.error: A new key event is dated more than 5 minutes before this hub's clock; correct the system clock and sign the event again.

cases.name: a poll carries the caller's notice
a poll of an agent whose tip names another hub says not_witness
an X-ANet-AID that is not an AID is unauthorized

body.error: X-ANet-AID is not an AID; sign the request as the agent's own AID, the one anet prints.
